_doc: Facts about sim2real at the locked commit. Sources are paths in the sim2real repo at that commit; 'source' cites where the fact was checked. Re-verify every entry when the lock changes. sim2real is checkout-only: pyproject.toml is declaration-only, nothing is installed, and the skill only prepares input and prints commands (references/sim2real.md).

min_python.source: pipeline/__init__.py MIN_PYTHON, and pyproject.toml requires-python; the floor is dependency-driven (numpy's Requires-Python), the code itself carries no 3.12-only syntax

pyproject_declaration_only.source: pyproject.toml header comment: 'Declaration only — not built or installed as a package'; the install path is pip install -r requirements.txt

no_sim2real_executable.source: follows from pyproject_declaration_only: the bare `sim2real translation register` in byo.py's output is shorthand; the real command is `python pipeline/sim2real.py --experiment-root <abs> translation register ...` from the checkout

register_spec_form.source: pipeline/README.md 'Register a translation'; the separate --algorithm/--image/--config form still parses but is deprecated (N=1, warns)

pipeline_subcommands.source: pipeline/README.md section headers; sim2real.py's `use` and `list runs` manage runs independently of the main flow

experiment_root_is_top_level_flag.source: references/sim2real.md 'The register command': --experiment-root must precede `translation` and argparse rejects it after `register`; without it sim2real uses the cwd

bootstrap_skill.source: the bootstrap skill the owner runs from the sim2real checkout; BLIS mode (default) and --byo mode are both documented there
